_comment: Display width in CSS px of each fragment in poster-template.html. Kept beside the template so prep-fragments.sh and the CSS cannot drift: a fragment resized to anything other than the width it is displayed at gets resampled by the renderer, which is what makes a poster look soft. Change one, change the other. The phone entries are widths ONLY — a phone fragment is the whole uncropped screenshot and keeps the device's 0.46 aspect, so 230 wide is 500 tall. Never crop one shorter to fit.
